sentences.text: Jesus Owono plays for Equatorial Guinea at international level FC Andorra goalkeeper Jesus Owono has been given a 12-match suspension by the Spanish football federation's disciplinary committee after his challenge which resulted in the death of Tenerife forward Jesus de Miguel.
sentences.article_title: Goalkeeper involved in fatal collision gets 12-game ban

sentences.text: Owono, 25, was sent off after colliding with De Miguel during the closing stages of the second-tier match between their two respective sides on 2 November.

sentences.text: De Miguel died the following day, aged 30.

sentences.text: The disciplinary committee said it had to base its decision "on the facts expressly recorded in the referee's report", which stated the player "was sent off for 'violently striking an opponent in the chest with his leg, using excessive force, while the ball was in play'.

sentences.text: "The tragic outcome of the incident, resulting in the death of Jesus de Miguel Alameda, is public knowledge." The committee added the "nature of the conduct described and the accompanying circumstances" means that "the maximum sanction, a 12-match suspension, is justified".

sentences.text: On Monday, disgraced entertainer Russell Brand was jailed for rape and sexual assault.

sentences.text: These are all very different stories, but each can be seen as a major reckoning with abuse of power and culture in the industry.

sentences.text: So why is this all happening now?

sentences.article_title: Brand, Walliams and MAFS: Is this a reckoning for the entertainment industry?

sentences.text: From my own experience - including in my Panorama on Married at First Sight UK - I know investigations typically take a very long time to reach a conclusion, from initial tip-off, to evidence-gathering, corroboration, getting responses, and eventually reporting.

sentences.article_title: Brand, Walliams and MAFS: Is this a reckoning for the entertainment industry?

sentences.text: The Pope, who has Peruvian citizenship, lived in Chiclayo for several years Pope Leo XIV has celebrated Mass near the Peruvian city where he made his name as a compassionate bishop who worked closely with poor and migrant communities.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: The ceremony was held on Friday at a park in Pimentel, about 10km (six miles) from Chiclayo in northern Peru as part of his tour of Latin America.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: The Vatican estimates more than 1.5 million people gathered to welcome the pontiff.

sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: They waited eagerly for his arrival despite spending long hours out in the open with the temperature pushing past 30C.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: For many living here, the fact that the Pope worked extensively in this region before becoming the head of the Catholic Church has put them in the spotlight.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: "The Pope has come home and Chiclayo is celebrating," said Lisbeth Díaz, a teacher who worked with Pope Leo when he served as the city's bishop between 2015 and 2023.

sentences.text: Lisbeth Díaz says Chiclayo is celebrating the Pope's return Peru is the longest stop on the first tour of Latin America by the pontiff , who was elected in May 2025.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: The trip has also taken in Argentina and Uruguay, but his time in this country carries particular significance.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: The Pope not only lived in Peru for long periods between 1985 and 2023 but also became a citizen of the country in 2015, forging close ties with local communities.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: Around Chiclayo, it is hard to meet anyone who doesn't claim to be a friend of the Pope or have a special anecdote about him.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: Some recall how he would enjoy sampling Peruvian delicacies at El Trébol, a restaurant next to the city's cathedral.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: Others remember his love of tennis.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: But for many it's the more serious moments of his time here, such as helping launch soup kitchens during the Covid-19 pandemic, or wading through deep waters on horseback when floods hit the area.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: Several of these images are on display in a small museum dedicated to him at the entrance to the bishop's residence.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: Commemorative pictures of the Pope are sold in the main of square of Chiclayo, including a famous image of him visiting a remote village on horseback But for the city, and for a country that calls him the "Peruvian Pope", his return home means much more than a collection of photographs and anecdotes.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: Father Miranda also stressed the role the now-pontiff played in bringing people together.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: "If there is one thing Bishop Prevost worked for here," he added, referring to the Pope by his previous title, "it was unity".
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: Local businesses have been capitalising on the Pope's popularity to boost sales and hotels have sharply increased their nightly room rates.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: But that didn't seem to put off the faithful who gathered for the Mass.
sentences.article_title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own

sentences.text: Van Hollen, 67, said in a post on X on Thursday that Americans voted for change earlier this month and "to deliver, we need new leadership".

sentences.article_title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge

sentences.text: The move by Van Hollen, who represents Maryland, marks the most significant step by a high-profile Democrat to challenge the party's existing leadership following last week's midterms victory.
sentences.article_title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge

sentences.text: Announcing his plans to run in a post on X, he wrote that Americans had called on the party to "unrig an economy rigged against working people".
sentences.article_title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge

sentences.article_title: Democratic Senate leader Schumer set to face leadership challenge

sentences.text: Roseanna Hall is not the only African contestant to be affected by US visa restrictions Miss Universe Zimbabwe Roseanna Hall and several other contestants from Africa could miss this year's competition in Puerto Rico as they race to secure a US visa.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Hall is due to represent Zimbabwe at the 75th edition of the Miss Universe pageant, with the winner set to be crowned on 24 November.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: But she has yet to obtain a visa to travel to the US territory.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: "We have been back and forth, trying to get my visa approved," Hall said in a video posted on her Instagram page.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Hall is not the only African contestant to be affected by the restrictions.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Zambia has withdrawn its representative, Pamela Mubanga, from the competition because of US travel restrictions.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Contestants began arriving in Puerto Rico on 8 November for registration, fittings and other pre-pageant activities, putting pressure on Hall, and others including the representative from South Sudan, to secure their visas.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: "Officially, today is the day I was supposed to be leaving for Puerto Rico for the 75th edition of Miss Universe," Hall said.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Zimbabwe is among 19 countries subject to partial US travel restrictions introduced under the Presidential Proclamation 10998, which took effect on 1 January 2026.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: The measures suspend the issuance of visitor, student and exchange visas, as well as immigrant visas, to nationals of the affected countries.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: They also impose restrictions on other categories of non-immigrant visas.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: In a statement, the Miss Universe organization in Zambia said Mubanga's situation was a consequence of the travel restrictions rather than individual circumstances.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: "Unlike situations where a contestant's visa is denied due to personal circumstances, documentation or organisational challenges, Mubanga's situation is linked to the United States' presidential travel restriction affecting Zambia and other African countries," the statement read.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Mubanga, 25, a registered nurse, was crowned Miss Universe Zambia on 8 October and was due to represent the country at the international pageant.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: The statement said five other African countries faced similar difficulties, although it did not name them.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Hall said she shared their concerns, adding that she had spent the past few weeks in South Africa trying to secure her visa.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: "I am not alone in this predicament.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Some of my African sisters are facing the same predicament, and I know exactly what they are going through," she said.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Miss Universe South Sudan also expressed uncertainty about her participation, commenting on Hall's video: "It is 50/50 whether we will make it, Miss Universe." In another video posted three days earlier, Hall said she was still hoping to make it to Puerto Rico.
sentences.article_title: African Miss Universe beauty queens in limbo as US visa restrictions bite

sentences.text: Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba has signalled his intention to run for president in the next elections In Uganda's military, even senior generals are finding that their rank offers little protection from the wrath of the country's powerful army chief.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Over the past 15 months, at least a dozen generals and senior officers have been arrested under Gen Muhoozi Kainerugaba, who is also the son of President Yoweri Museveni, in a crackdown that has unsettled the military's top ranks.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The arrests come amid growing political tensions over who will succeed Museveni, who has ruled Uganda for four decades.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Gen Kainerugaba, 52, is widely seen as a potential successor, although his ambitions appear to be facing resistance within the ruling party.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: This week, he threatened Vice-President Jessica Alupo with dismissal and possible arrest, while suggesting he should take her position.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The ruling National Resistance Movement (NRM) has, however, rejected reports that its senior leadership had rejected a proposal to back Gen Kainerugaba as the next president, describing the claims as "completely false".
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: This has all fuelled speculation that the arrests are part of an effort to sideline military officers opposed to the general's presidential ambitions.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Others see the arrests as evidence of an anti-corruption drive in which senior commanders are held to account.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: At the centre of the tension are two powerful powerful institutions: the military, where Gen Kainerugaba wields considerable influence, and the NRM, where questions about his political ambitions appear to be dividing senior figures.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: A recent meeting of NRM's top leadership ended without agreement on a proposal to position Gen Kainerugaba as Museveni's successor, according to the AFP news agency.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Five party sources who attended the closed-door meeting told AFP that a vote was abandoned after several members spoke against the proposal.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Uganda's news website ChimpReports, however, said that most members who spoke backed the general's potential presidency, although some questioned his readiness for civilian leadership.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: In a statement on Thursday, NRM Secretary General Richard Todwong Awany confirmed that the party had met on 10 November to discuss "political, social and economic issues".
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He dismissed reports that the meeting had rejected a proposal to position Gen Kainerugaba as Uganda's next president, saying the party would communicate any decisions "through the right channel, at the right time".
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: "Senior officers believed not to support the project have been arrested, detained or charged with corruption and treason," he tells the BBC.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He says the allegations against some officers were widely viewed as politically motivated, reflecting growing divisions within the military over the succession question.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Some of those detained have since been released, apparently after securing the general's forgiveness.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The detention of one of the country's most prominent former commanders, Lt Gen Peter Elwelu , has brought the crackdown into sharper focus.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The former deputy army chief was detained on 2 November over allegations that he had plotted to destabilise the eastern Teso region.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: His fall from grace followed a series of social media posts by Kainerugaba, who accused him of treachery and announced that he had been stripped of his three-star rank and demoted.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: "The traitor Peter Elwelu is hereby stripped of his ranks.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He is demoted to Private," Kainerugaba wrote on X.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He also claimed that more than 20 soldiers linked to Elwelu had been arrested.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The announcement raised legal questions, with Ugandan media reporting that military regulations do not allow a senior officer to be stripped of his rank through a social media post.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The army later confirmed Elwelu's detention, saying they had recovered 15 guns, military uniforms and two pickup trucks linked to him.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: His family has rejected the allegations.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Elwelu is among at least a dozen generals and senior officers detained since April 2025, according to an investigation by Uganda's Daily Monitor newspaper.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: They include three former military intelligence chiefs who once oversaw some of Uganda's most sensitive security operations.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He was charged before a military court but later released after Gen Kainerugaba announced that he had "forgiven" him.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Another former intelligence chief, Maj Gen Abel Kandiho, was detained in September this year over allegations of providing false intelligence and treachery.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He remains in detention, according to the Daily Monitor.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: His predecessor, Brig-Gen Charles Bakahumura, was also arrested in September over similar allegations, but was later released after the army chief announced that he had forgiven him.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Other officers have faced accusations ranging from stealing military fuel to taking money to spy on military communications.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The military has defended the arrests as part of efforts to tackle corruption and criminality within the armed forces.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Maj Gen James Birungi was arrested in August 2025, on allegations including treason, terrorism and corruption Ugandan security analyst Freddie David Egesa says the arrests reflect investigations involving different security agencies, rather than an army-led purge.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He argues that detaining senior officers helps protect witnesses and demonstrates the seriousness of the anti-corruption drive.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: "The result is a broad purge that has affected both serving and retired officers perceived to be anti-Muhoozi," he says.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He points to divisions between the elite Special Forces Command (SFC), which he says is largely loyal to the president's son, and army commanders who remain unconvinced about his succession.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The allegations against the officers are at different stages, with some facing charges, others in detention without publicly announced charges, and several having been released.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Bareebe also questions whether military trials can deliver independent proceedings.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: "Many Ugandans regard the charges as politically motivated and therefore expect little justice," he adds.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He alleges that some officers have had charges dropped after closed-door negotiations with the president and his son, during which they were pressured to declare support for Gen Kainerugaba.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Government spokesperson Allan Kasujja dismissed the claims of a succession fallout as "hogwash".
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Unlike his predecessors, who communicated through official military channels, Gen Kainerugaba frequently uses X to announce arrests, criticise public officials and comment on domestic and international affairs.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Some have sparked diplomatic controversy.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: On the night of 9 November, he turned his attention to Vice-President Jessica Alupo, demanding to take her job.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: "Whoever is in that office should prepare to hand it over soon," he wrote, in posts that he later deleted.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: He also questioned Alupo's loyalty and threatened her dismissal, adding that the government would operate "on military terms", if he became his father's deputy.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: The following day, his X account, which had nearly 1.4 million followers, became inaccessible.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: It was unclear whether he deactivated it himself, which he has done before, or the platform had suspended it.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Alupo remains in office and has yet to respond publicly.
sentences.article_title: Arrested generals and a threatened VP: President's son fuels Ugandan succession fever

sentences.text: Bilal Kazi, 27, tricked his victims, who were from across the UK, into sending images A man who groomed at least 70 girls and manipulated them into sending sexually explicit videos and images of themselves has been sentenced to 30 years in prison.

sentences.text: Bilal Kazi, 27, targeted his victims - aged between 10 and 17 - using apps including Snapchat, Wink and Roblox between August 2021 and August 2025.
sentences.article_title: Man jailed for grooming at least 70 girls online

sentences.text: Kazi, a student from India who was studying at the University of Chester, posed as a 14-year-old white British teenage boy and made his victims believe they were in a relationship with him.
sentences.article_title: Man jailed for grooming at least 70 girls online

sentences.text: He was jailed after pleading guilty to 37 charges including making indecent images, blackmail and inciting a child to engage in sexual activity.
sentences.article_title: Man jailed for grooming at least 70 girls online

sentences.article_title: Man jailed for grooming at least 70 girls online

sentences.article_title: Man jailed for grooming at least 70 girls online

sentences.article_title: Man jailed for grooming at least 70 girls online

sentences.article_title: Man jailed for grooming at least 70 girls online

sentences.text: The government has been accused of dragging its feet on its manifesto promise to ban the import of hunting trophies.
sentences.article_title: MPs urge Labour ministers to get on with trophy hunting ban

sentences.text: Labour pledged at the 2024 general election to outlaw bringing the parts of animals killed by hunters for sport, such as heads or horns, into the UK.

sentences.text: But it has so far failed to bring a bill enacting the ban to Parliament, and in the two years since the election more than 40 import permits have been granted for hunting trophies.

sentences.text: This video can not be played Watch: Chris Cash says counter-terror officers entered his bedroom and arrested him A British man who was charged with spying for China has told the BBC he was a "convenient fall guy" for UK police and security services who wanted to put espionage threats by foreign states "on the map".

sentences.text: Chris Cash, a former parliamentary researcher, has shared more than 6,000 messages with us revealing how a Chinese official sought information about sensitive political matters in the UK - including the 2022 Tory leadership battle to decide the next prime minister.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The messages show how Cash's friend in China, Chris Berry - with whom he had been sharing information - dramatically described a "secret" meeting between Berry and a high-ranking Chinese official.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Berry said he had been told that China was concerned about how a British MP it had sanctioned might be promoted to a cabinet role.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The messages also reveal how Cash used his friend as a reference during vetting for a parliamentary pass - which was approved.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Like Cash, Berry was also charged with espionage.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The two men consistently maintained their innocence.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: In Cash's first interview since his acquittal, which sparked a political row over the government's failure to designate China as a "threat", he says he would "never do anything" to harm UK national security.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: But he admits he was "unprofessional and naive" to send "gossiping" texts to his friend, whom he met in 2018 when they both taught English in a school in China.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Although the trove of messages shows him discussing sensitive topics, there is no evidence in them that Cash was paid by, or sympathetic to, the Chinese Communist Party.

sentences.text: Berry declined to comment on this story, but at the time of his acquittal said he denied any wrongdoing and that he had been "unfairly subjected to a trial by media".

sentences.text: He said he had provided reports to a Chinese company, which he believed had clients seeking to develop trading links with the UK, and those reports contained no classified information and relied on public sources.

sentences.text: Cash returned to the UK in 2019, saying in his resignation message for his job in China that he felt "guilty sitting back and participating in a system that I am uncomfortable with".

sentences.text: He later became the director of a small policy group run by China-sceptic Conservative MPs in Westminster.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Meanwhile, Berry stayed in China writing reports for a large consultancy which, like many Chinese companies, has links to the government.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: England and Wales' top prosecutor said the case had collapsed last autumn because government officials could not say China had been classed as an "enemy" at the time.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: This prompted accusations of UK political interference to placate the Chinese government.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: China has previously called the allegations of spying "pure fabrication and malicious slander".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The most striking section of the messages handed to the BBC concerns Berry's account of his meeting in summer 2022 with a senior Chinese official who wanted to have "a more detailed co-operation".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: In voice notes Berry describes how, beforehand, work colleagues had told him the official's interest had been piqued by reports Berry had written, which included details of the UK's foreign policy approach to China.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The experience "felt like a psychological game of chess" and "like a test", Berry says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He kept his hands under the table as tea was served: "I didn't want it to be obvious if I was nervous.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: I tested to see if my hands were shaking first, then drank the tea." Berry describes the senior Chinese official asking via an interpreter "about the situation in the UK at the moment, about the Tory leadership thing".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: At that time, Boris Johnson had just resigned as the UK's prime minister, and a Conservative leadership battle was taking place, which Liz Truss would go on to win.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Berry says he jokingly tried to ask his host which candidate China wanted, but the interpreter did not translate his question.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "And then the main guy just shakes my hand like it's time to go," Berry tells Cash.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: After receiving the voice notes, Cash replies via text the next day: "You, my friend, have just been elite captured" before adding: "You're in spy territory now".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: In many media reports these particular messages, previously released in a government witness statement, have been presented as a smoking gun - evidence that Cash knew his friend was passing on information to the Chinese state.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: But Cash insists it was a "tongue-in-cheek joke" because he knew his friend to be "a staunch critic of the Chinese Communist Party".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The next morning, he made a joke about Berry spying for the UK and getting in trouble with the Chinese authorities, he says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash texted: "Keep him sweet… We may have a use for you yet".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I didn't believe he was knowingly spying on the UK through me," says Cash.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I trusted my friend… I wish I had seen the danger earlier, spotted it and cut off all contact." So who was the mystery official Berry had met?
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I found out who this guy is," Berry text-messaged Cash a few hours later.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "Bigger deal than I thought." Berry posted a link to the Wikipedia page of Cai Qi, who at the time was one of China's most influential politicians and is now, in effect, President Xi Jinping's chief of staff.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Berry identified Cai Qi (left) as the man he had met - a trusted aide of Chinese President Xi Jinping Whether Berry correctly identified his host remains unclear.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He has since disputed the suggestion that he met someone as senior as Cai Qi.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: What is beyond dispute is that he believed he may have met someone highly placed within the Chinese political system.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: For Chris Cash, this unusual encounter did not prompt alarm bells.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Asked why not, Cash tells the BBC: "Because I didn't think anything of the meeting, really." We ask Cash why his friend might have been asked to such a meeting.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "Strange things happen in China... you know we would often brush shoulders with sort of quite senior members of the Chinese communist party," he tells us.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Challenged about whether he had read the Wikipedia link at the time, Cash says he had "skimmed it", adding that it described him as a judge and a provincial-level official.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I just thought it was a weird meeting with a guy who'd taken an interest," he says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Six months later, Berry said in text messages that "off the record" he had it "on pretty good authority" that China was considering dropping sanctions against Tom Tugendhat, one of the Conservative MPs in the China Research Group, where Cash worked.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Berry wrote that this would happen as long as the West "continued to show signals that they are willing to work together".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The Chinese believed it would be "extremely embarrassing" if Tugendhat became prime minister or foreign secretary while under Chinese sanctions, Berry said.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: At the time of the meeting in summer 2022, China-sceptic Tugendhat was seen as a possible contender to succeed Boris Johnson, or become UK foreign secretary.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He was actually appointed as security minister by Liz Truss, and Beijing lifted sanctions on him in January 2026.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Was Cash concerned that Berry appeared to be passing information to him about Chinese foreign policy?
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash says he assumed Berry had heard this "through the grapevine at his company" which was doing business with the UK.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He says he never doubted his friend's trustworthiness, to the extent he even named Berry as a reference on his application for a security pass for the Palace of Westminster.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The pass was granted and, a fortnight before their arrests in early 2023, Cash invited Berry to Parliament for lunch.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: It was to be their final face-to-face conversation.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash was in bed at quarter to six on a March morning when he was woken by car doors being shut, he says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Within seconds, four UK counter-terrorism officers had barged into his bedroom at his parents' home in Edinburgh.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "They told me to sit up and not touch anything and then said I was under arrest for breaching the Official Secrets Act," Cash says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I was in complete shock… quivering...
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: My mum was hysterical." Cash says the officers dressed him in dirty clothes he had worn that weekend, handcuffed him and marched him down to an unmarked police car.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He was later driven to London.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Chris Berry was also arrested the same day.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: It remains unclear how, when and why British security services became interested in the exchanges between the two friends.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: But they are likely to have found out far more about their relationship when Berry was stopped and questioned by counter-terror officers at Heathrow Airport.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: His laptop and phone were taken - this may have enabled his Signal chats to be downloaded.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Berry later messaged Cash about it.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The allegations were based on 6,273 messages between the pair - the same ones Cash has now shared with the BBC.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash's solicitor has told the BBC they are genuine.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: They cover a period when Cash had joined the China Research Group (CRG), founded by Tugendhat and fellow Tory MP Alicia Kearns, and when Berry was working for a Chinese company called Strong, where part of his work involved writing political and economic reports for clients.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: According to court documents, Berry was said to have compiled 34 reports for a man linked to the Chinese state spy agency, relaying information passed on to him by Cash.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Strong did not respond to the BBC's request for comment.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The CRG's office was across the Thames from Westminster, but Cash regularly had meetings in Parliament.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash did not have government security clearance and there is no evidence he had access to classified documents.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Despite being thousands of miles apart, the two friends remained in close contact, often messaging daily.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: The messages reviewed by the BBC show them discussing topics including sanctions on China, the tech company Huawei, human rights, Hong Kong, Taiwan and British foreign policy.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash says he used the Signal app for almost all his contacts with people in China - "more for their protection" - as he says discussing the government "could land someone… in trouble".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He and Berry did not use the app's "disappearing messages" function.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Much of the information they discussed was publicly available, says Cash - who has given the BBC a detailed spreadsheet with links and references in an attempt to prove it.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: But sometimes he did share with Berry his impressions from meetings and private discussions in Westminster.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: On 12 occasions in the messages, he labelled information "off the record" or "very off the record" before passing it on.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash says this was "just me excitedly sharing things that I was doing with him at work".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: One message recounted views allegedly expressed in private by Britain's then-ambassador to China, Dame Caroline Wilson, during a discussion with the CRG about its work on China's influence on UK universities.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash also messaged Berry sharing unverified rumours about the sex lives of two UK cabinet ministers.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: There is no evidence Berry passed this to his Chinese colleagues.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash says he regarded such exchanges as routine political discussion.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "We weren't working with classified information," he says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash was told by his solicitor the police investigation would blow over after six months and he would soon be able to return to normal life.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: But in September 2023 - six months after the arrests - the case became public when the Sunday Times broke the story of an unnamed "spy" who had been arrested in Parliament.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash recalls travelling on a train while, around him, fellow passengers read the  newspaper's front page story: "Commons 'Chinese spy' arrested".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He says: "I wanted the world to eat me up." Within 24 hours he was named and pictured in the press, and both men were later charged with espionage.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: In September the following year, just weeks before their trial was due to begin, Cash received an unexpected call from his solicitor.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "Are you sitting down?" he asked Cash.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "They've dropped all the charges." His lawyers requested a court hearing for the prosecution to formally acknowledge that they would offer no evidence, but at the Old Bailey the newly-innocent Cash struggled to find anyone interested in his story.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Cash's life has changed almost beyond recognition, he says, but he is positive about the future At every previous court appearance he had been mobbed, but the press had not been informed about this hearing.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Eventually his team found a lone BBC journalist.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I said my piece outside the Old Bailey.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: And that was a real high point.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: I felt that I could start to move on with my life." It wouldn't be that simple.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Across the city, House of Commons Speaker Lindsay Hoyle was seething.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "It is this Parliament that has been spied on," he declared.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "It is MPs' offices that have been infiltrated." There would be days of political debate and a raucous prime minister's questions where Tory leader Kemi Badenoch would claim: "This all stinks of a cover-up." "I'd been acquitted by law, but then I was traduced in Parliament," Cash says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "It was almost like I was convicted in the court of public opinion again, by people who I had worked with and trusted and that felt horrible." Today Cash's life is almost unrecognisable.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He has lost his dream job, his relationship, and his closest friend from university.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "We talked about being each other's best men," Cash says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Instead, when the friend got married last year, Cash was not even invited.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: He is also no longer in contact with Berry.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I've been applying for basic admin jobs and having trouble recently," Cash says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I'm angry and upset with how everything played out, and I do feel let down." But when asked, Cash stops short of saying he feels Berry betrayed him.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Does he think his friend was spying for the Chinese government?
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "He would have to have his time in court to defend himself," Cash answers.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "I think it'd be wrong of me to speculate and hypocritical given the speculation that I've been subject to.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: But we're no longer friends." Berry declined to comment on this story, but at the time of his acquittal said his reports "concerned economic and commercial issues widely discussed in the UK at the time and drew on information freely in the public domain".
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Like his former friend, Chris Cash is innocent in the eyes of the law, but his reputation has undoubtedly been trashed.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: Many in Parliament still think they were spies.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: And with more of the messages between these former friends now revealed, the debate over their actions could be reignited.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "It was a gruelling ordeal," Cash says.
sentences.article_title: Acquitted 'China spy' tells BBC: I was fall guy for security services but also naive

sentences.text: "But I'm a fundamentally positive person… I'm positive about what the future holds." Get in touch – politicsinvestigations@bbc.co.uk , external

sentences.text: Andy Burnham has signalled his support for dedicated options at the next census to allow people to define themselves as black English or Asian English.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: It comes after Liberal Democrat MP Josh Babarinde called for legislation to widen ethnicity options for respondents at the next population count, due in 2031.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: The last census, held in 2021, saw English offered within a broader white category, but without specific options for black English or Asian English.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Asked at Prime Minister's Questions whether he would support Babarinde's proposal, Burnham said he had not seen details of the plan.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: But he added: "I stand here thinking that I would want to support that bill, to directly take on the poisonous politics we've seen from some in this House".
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: "We must bring people back together.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: I am interested in working with anyone in this House who shares that aim," he added.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Burnham did not respond to a follow-up question from Lib Dem leader Sir Ed Davey about whether he would meet Babarinde to discuss his plan, and he did not specify whether the government would give it time for debate in Parliament.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Babarinde introduced his proposal for legislation on Tuesday, under a rule that allows MPs to propose new laws in a 10-minute speech.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Such draft laws, known as private members' bills, rarely become law without support from the government of the day but are often used by MPs to raise awareness of issues and generate media attention for policy ideas.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Census should include black English and Asian English options, says MP Respondents to the 2021 census were asked a two-stage question about ethnicity, with options grouped under five broad ethnic headings.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: In Wales, the terms "Asian Welsh" and "Black Welsh" were listed in the broad categories themselves, and respondents were able to pick "Welsh" as an option underneath the broader white category.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: The form in England listed "English" as an option in the white ethnic category, but the only way for respondents to describe themselves as Black English or Black English was via a free-form text box.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: In Scotland, the term "Scottish Asian" appeared in the broad categories, whilst "Black Scottish" was given as an example response for the text box.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Speaking on Tuesday, Babarinde said his proposed law would introduce Black English and Asian English as specific new categories, arguing that the text box on the current form "may as well be the margin".
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Babarinde's proposal has been backed by some MPs in other parties, including Labour former deputy prime minister David Lammy and Conservative Sir James Cleverly, who quit the shadow cabinet this summer to run for London mayor.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: The Eastbourne MP has previously told the BBC he put forward his bill in the wake of comments by former Conservative home secretary Suella Braverman, who defected to Reform UK earlier this year.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Braverman wrote in 2015 , external that she was British Asian but said she "cannot claim to be English" despite being born and educated in England.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: She has reaffirmed her position in recent weeks, writing on X that Englishness was "an ethnicity" and it was "not racist to say this".
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: "To say I'm English is to take a 'laissez-faire, anything-goes' attitude to ethnicity, citizenship and identity.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: It also denies me my Asian heritage," she added.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: The detailed questions asked during the census in England and Wales are set out in legislation following recommendations from the Office for National Statistics (ONS).
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: The ONS told the BBC that the Government Statistical Service has been working on a new approach to asking about ethnicity in official surveys since 2022, with an update on the work due to be published on Thursday.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: That could lead to a recommendation to change the ethnicity question at the 2031 census, although the questionnaire itself is normally designed much closer to the time the census is due to take place.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: Legislation setting out the questions for the last census was published in summer 2020, ahead of it taking place in March the following year.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: The Scottish government delayed the census in Scotland until 2022 because of the Covid pandemic.
sentences.article_title: Burnham signals backing for more ethnicity options on next census

sentences.text: PM Andy Burnham was the only G7 leader to go to COP31 Prime Minister Andy Burnham has warned that the consensus on both science and climate change has "gone".
sentences.article_title: Burnham says climate consensus 'gone' but pledges 'new era of leadership'

sentences.text: Addressing other world leaders and delegates at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey, he said that despite this, the UK was ready to begin a "new era of British leadership" on the climate change issue.
sentences.article_title: Burnham says climate consensus 'gone' but pledges 'new era of leadership'

sentences.text: But environmental campaigners at the summit said the PM had to back up his warm words with stronger actions.
sentences.article_title: Burnham says climate consensus 'gone' but pledges 'new era of leadership'

sentences.text: In recent months, the UK government has announced policies which critics say have weakened its green credentials, such as reducing support for heat pumps, approving the Jackdaw gas field and doubling down on support for Heathrow Airport's expansion.

sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: In Scotland , external , the government has said it will introduce a new law to restrict the personal use of phones in schools, and launched a consultation on the issue over the summer.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: In Wales , external , the Senedd recently voted against a motion to introduce a national statutory ban on phones in classrooms.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: The Welsh government launched a 12-week consultation in September, which it says will shape its guidance to support schools in developing a mobile phone policy.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Schools are still encouraged to restrict the use of phones during the school day, but heads have flexibility over how to implement their own rules.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: And in Northern Ireland , Education Minister Paul Givan launched a 12-week consultation in August on whether to ban mobile phones from schools by law, calling for "a stronger and more consistent approach across our education system".
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Rules around phones in schools are separate from the UK's upcoming ban on social media for under-16s, due to be introduced in March.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Too many university students can use AI to complete assessments without staff finding out, the higher education regulator in England has said.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: The Office for Students (OfS) said "a significant proportion" of assessments are unsupervised and many can be completed to a high standard with AI, sometimes in minutes.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: It said this posed a "significant risk" to their credibility, and closed-book and practical exams were the most effective forms of assessments.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Universities UK said many institutions had "made substantial changes" to make assessments "AI-proof".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Universities that do not meet OfS quality standards could soon be banned from charging increased tuition fees or have caps imposed on their student numbers, under proposals that are now being consulted on.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: The new research from the OfS and Advance HE, a charity that gives awards for teaching excellence, is based on the views of 244 higher education staff and 91 students from at least 127 universities.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: It said "a significant proportion of assessments" were in "unsupervised, non-controlled formats where AI can be accessed by students completing them".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "Many of these can be completed to a high standard using AI tools with limited engagement from students," it added.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: It also concluded it was "frequently possible" for students to use AI "in ways that cannot be reliably detected".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Unsupervised assessment can include coursework, but also remote online exams.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: They were rolled out widely during Covid, and research from Swansea University , external last year suggests 93 universities in the UK still use them in some form.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Josh Fleming, director of strategy and delivery at the OfS, said there were "fantastic" examples of universities seizing opportunities presented by AI, but there should be "far greater use of AI-free assessment".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "It also presents a generational risk to the system as it stands, threatening to undermine students' learning and institutions' ability to assess them," he said.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Kathryn Harrison-Graves, deputy chief executive at Advance HE, said students wanted "greater clarity about what is expected of them" but staff had "varying levels of confidence and support".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Some staff, meanwhile, were receiving lots of assignments that looked the same, and did not think their institution's assessments were "fit for purpose".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Other staff described a "polarised atmosphere" between students who used AI and other "conscientious objectors" who avoided it on environmental and other grounds.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: The research said AI literacy for students was important during and after university, and some institutions were clearly communicating to students where AI can and cannot be used in assessments.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: But it said there was "an urgent need" to ensure that remote or "non-secure" assessments "maintain their validity despite the availability of AI tools, meaning they effectively assess the knowledge and skills they are designed to measure".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "If it becomes possible to complete an assessment using AI without the knowledge and skills being tested, the assessment should be replaced," it added.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Universities UK, which represents more than 140 institutions, said universities were "making significant progress" adapting to AI.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "There is further to go but many have made substantial changes to how they assess students.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: This includes more in-person exams, presentations, vivas, process-based assessment and assessments that integrate AI in a controlled way," a spokesperson said.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "It's time to get rid of the outdated methods, that have been kept around in the name of tradition, and instead encourage the innovative practice we see across the sector, co-designed with students based on what they want from higher education," he said.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns
