sentences.text: Ojomoh put in superb performance against Argentina last autumn, scoring a try in a 27-23 win Centre Max Ojomoh - labelled "one of the most talented players in English rugby" - has been challenged to produce a relentless and physical performance against Japan on Saturday.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: The Bath man burst on to the international scene in a man-of-the-match display against Argentina at the end of 2025, but has not played for his country in the 12 months since.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: Ojomoh was initially left out of Steve Borthwick's wider training squad but after starring for the 'A' team has been catapulted back into the England number 12 shirt and with it World Cup contention.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "Max is one of the most talented players in English rugby," boss Steve Borthwick told BBC Sport.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "His ability to see space and distribute, to hide where he is going to pass and to pass short or long, that's a rare skill." However Borthwick says the position of centre has changed markedly over the years, and it now requires a level of unyielding physical output to go with a wide skill-set.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "You have to be incredibly skilled in that position, but it demands a skill and toughness it previously probably didn't," he explained.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "It used to be a second receiver, that second pair of eyes, the distribution skills and the potential kicking skills.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "Now they've got to hit and they've got to run in attack and they've got to run in defence, and our centres are involved in a lot of rucks in wider channels.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "Can they get the ball back?
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: And can they tackle with impact to get the ball back?
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: So when I'm talking about centres, I want the incredible skill and I want the incredible toughness.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: Speaking in depth to the Rugby Union Weekly podcast , Ford says one of his main jobs against the Blossoms is to get England's best athletes on the ball as much as possible.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: So you can simplify it," Ford said.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "How many times can we get the ball in Will Joseph's hands this week?
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: I want him to have double-figure touches.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: Same with Cadan, same with Max Ojomoh.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "When you are analysing, if you just bring it back to the simplest terms, these guys are unbelievable athletes with skill.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: They need time and space.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: So how do you get the ball to them in time and space?
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: Just give it to them and let them go." Saturday 14 November, 16:40 GMT Allianz Stadium, Twickenham Live on BBC Radio 5 Live, the BBC Sport website and app With Fin Smith rested, Ford is preferred to Marcus Smith at fly-half, with the latter again being deployed as a utility option off the bench.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: For Ford, the debate around the England number 10s is nothing new.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "It's been like this all my England career.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: A lot has been spoken about fly-half in particular and who starts.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: And 12 years ago now when I first came in, it was the same," he said.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "Genuinely the three of us, our relationship, the respect we have for each other but how competitive we are as well, is probably the best I've experienced within the England team.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "We understand selection is very subjective and Steve will pick a 23 that he thinks is the best formula to win the game.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "For the team to succeed, for the team to win, for the team to go and win the Nations Championship or to go and win a World Cup in 12 months' time, it's going to need three high-quality, brilliant 10s who are great people as well.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "Fin has been amazing, the way he's played for Northampton, the way he's played for England, he's took it to a new level in his game.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "Marcus has started the season like a house on fire when he came back from his injury at Quins and you know what versatility he's got and how he can influence the game.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "And hopefully I can add when I am playing, when I'm not playing, maybe in a different kind of way.
sentences.article_title: Borthwick challenges Ojomoh to match talent with toughness

sentences.text: "So what I'm saying is you get the one who's starting at the weekend, you probably get another one of us who's on the bench, but it's like a three-man job to get the team ready for every week.

sentences.text: Pro-government forces marched into Tigray's capital less than two weeks after the war began Running a hair salon in Mekelle, capital of Ethiopia's troubled northern Tigray region, is not easy at the moment.

sentences.text: "People can't prioritise beauty over daily basic needs.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: For many residents, thinking about self-care is a luxury, at a time when they can't feed their kids," Firut Me'ar, who runs a salon in the city, tells the BBC.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: After a brief war, the city is under the control of the national army but life is far from normal, says Firut, a single mother of a 10-year-old daughter.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: "Things are better than during the war, but people still have no money, no morale.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: Business is almost non-existent," she says, her voice shaking with emotion.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: Above all, she says people are worried about what the future holds.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: "There is uncertainty about what comes next." Fighting broke out in late September between the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), the party that had run Tigray for decades, and the national army - a resumption of the two-year civil war that officially ended in 2022.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: But within less than two weeks, federal forces marched triumphantly into Mekelle.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: The TPLF made what it called a "strategic withdrawal" from the city and Tigray's other main towns so the army encountered little resistance.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: Hundreds of people are reported to have died in the conflict, including dozens killed by drone strikes and bombing raids by the air force.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: Ethiopian government officials and supporters argue that the war is effectively over and that the only remaining task is to clear Tigray of TPLF elements.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: Getachew Reda, a senior TPLF official who switched sides and is now an adviser to the prime minister, declared that the war in Tigray had ended and that stabilising the region should now be the immediate priority.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: Cameroon Hudson, an analyst and consultant on African peace and security, says there are various reasons for the TPLF's rapid defeat.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: "The TPLF has lost popular support at home.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: It is fragmented, it does not possess the advanced military technology necessary to match the ENDF [Ethiopian National Defence Forces]," he says.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: "It has lost many of its generals, strategic thinkers, finest diplomats and fighters, either through defections or arrests.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: The infighting within the TPLF leadership has caused significant damage." Abraha Hailezgi, a scholar at Mekelle University, agrees.
sentences.article_title: Neither war nor peace in Tigray - is Ethiopia's latest conflict really over?

sentences.text: "The army lacks a clear political vision.

sentences.text: Somalia has the longest coastline in mainland Africa As the sun rises over the Indian Ocean, waves lap onto the golden sands while palm fronds rustle in the cool sea breeze.

sentences.text: Sucdi Abdul Fattah Abdul Khader is among a growing number of local guides taking visitors beyond the headlines to explore Mogadishu's beauty spots, historic sites and culture.

sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: And honestly, that's what I saw in the media before I came, mostly negative headlines." But visiting the country challenged those perceptions.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "Coming here, on my very first trip, showed me that there is so much more to this country than what is shown in the headlines," he says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Romanian Mihaela Patap says she prefers to visit new countries without preconceived ideas Mihaela Patap, from Romania, loves Somalia's natural beauty.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Although she has spent only a few hours in Mogadishu, she has already visited the sand dunes and taken in the Indian Ocean coastline.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "The desert was so beautiful to see.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I have also enjoyed the beach, and the ocean.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: It is inspiring," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: Having travelled to Somalia from neighbouring Ethiopia, she says she has been struck by the people's friendliness.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I don't see anything dangerous.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I feel safe and the people are warm," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: An experienced traveller, Mihaela says she prefers to visit new countries without having preconceived ideas.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I travel the world to see new places, to see countries, to see the differences.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I don't take a picture in my mind to compare the reality with.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I'm just expecting the new to come to me," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She hopes to share her experience and encourage others to visit Somalia.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "I'm going to post my pictures and say good things about what I'm experiencing.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: I'm going to promote it," she says.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: For Sucdi, that potential is personal.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: She is continuing a family profession while building a business in an industry with few women and using digital platforms to reach audiences far beyond Mogadishu.
sentences.article_title: The young Somali woman changing how the world sees Mogadishu

sentences.text: "Somalia still has a long way to go before tourism becomes a major industry," she says.

sentences.text: In April, Rukayat Taiwo Suleimon became the first female blind sambist in the world to win a gold medal at a major international tournament Rukayat Taiwo Suleimon only took up sambo this year, but the Nigerian has already secured her place in the history of the martial art.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: The sport shares strong roots with judo and wrestling, combining techniques such as hip and leg throws to take opponents to the mat, where they can be pinned.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Originally developed by the Soviet Union's Red Army in the 1920s, it was officially recognised as a combat sport by USSR officials in 1938.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Competing at the 2026 World Sambo Cup in Armenia, Suleimon defeated Uzbekistan's Charos Ortikova in the final of the women's 54kg category to claim victory on her international debut.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: It was the first time that women with visual impairments had been included at the competition.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "Being the first female blind sambist in the world to win the gold medal makes me great," the 32-year-old told BBC Sport Africa.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "This is my first time in sambo and God crowned my efforts." Suleimon's achievement was part of a breakthrough moment for African women in the sport.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: She and compatriot Elizabeth Aseso, who competed in the 59kg category, were among the pioneering sambists representing the continent in Yerevan.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: For Suleimon, her gold medal is a reward for the hard work over many years which has seen her move from athletics to judo and now to the top of the international sambo podium.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "I really benefit a lot from sports and, despite my blindness, I achieve a lot," she said.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "If I [were] not blind, I don't think I would be at this level.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: I believe I will achieve even more." Suleimon is set to compete at the World Sambo Championships in Uzbekistan in November Suleimon's journey to becoming a champion has been marked by hardship and a determination to rebuild her life.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: After failed surgeries she lost her sight in 2009 because of glaucoma, an eye condition that damages the optic nerve and can lead to permanent loss of vision.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: The change in her circumstances affected her relationships, leaving her feeling isolated at a time when she needed support the most.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "People looked down on me.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: I would just stay indoors and cry," she explained.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "So many friends left me.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: They stopped communicating with me." Her life began to take a different direction after she attended a vocational training centre for blind people in Lagos.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Through a friend, she was introduced to a para-athletics coach who helped her discover her potential in sport.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Since 2011, Suleimon has won more than 20 national medals across sprint events (alongside guide runner Stephen Oyelakin), discus and shot put.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: She then began practicing judo and sambo.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "Since I [started] sports I have seen that where there is life, there is hope," she said.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "What sighted people can do, a blind person can do even better.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Suleimon has won national para-athletics medals in sprint events alongside guide runner Stephen Oyelakin (right) "I'm proud of myself because it's not easy to be a champion in athletics and in sambo.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: I don't want to lose the glory." Her achievements have also become a source of pride for her family.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Her twin sister Ganiyat Kehinde Suleimon says her sibling's disability has never defined her worth.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "She is someone we are all proud of.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: She is now a champion," Ganiyat told BBC Sport Africa.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "Her disability did not make her a liability to us." For Nigerian sambo coach Olugbenga Adekahunsi, Suleimon's performance in Yerevan offered a glimpse of what she can accomplish with the right support and continued development.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "I see a lot of quality in her because she is very strong and the confidence is there," he told BBC Sport Africa.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "I believe she will become a great sambist." Nigerian para-athletes have long complained about a lack of funding and facilities Suleimon says the recognition she has earned internationally has not been matched by adequate "support" at home.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: However, her victory is the latest milestone in Nigeria's growing presence in the discipline.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Two years ago Samuel Oladele Kekere became the first blind African to compete at the World Sambo Championships in Kazakhstan, and Sodiq Ajibade followed that with a bronze medal at last year's edition in Kyrgyzstan.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "Despite making Nigeria and the whole of Africa proud, there is nothing to show for it," Suleimon said.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Her concerns reflect wider complaints from Nigerian para-athletes about limited funding, inadequate specialist facilities and insufficient institutional backing, despite their achievements.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Sherif Hammed, vice-president of the Sambo Association of Nigeria, says a lack of resources can prevent talented athletes from reaching their full potential.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "When athletes do not have facilities to train, they cannot compete at the world level," he said.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "It is quite disheartening and heartbreaking.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "People with disabilities, particularly visually impaired athletes, sometimes feel that because of their challenges, they have no purpose in life." For Suleimon, a Lagos State judo champion, the journey to training is also an issue.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Travelling across the city and covering transport costs make maintaining a demanding schedule difficult.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "I leave home at 5.30am to make it to training on time," she explained.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "It takes a lot of money and sacrifice." Suleimon was unable to follow up her World Cup success at the World Sambo Championships in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, where blind women were again scheduled to compete for the first time.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Beaten in Friday's opening round by Moldova's Ina Cernei, she still hopes her exploits on the global stage can inspire others.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "I want to encourage my fellow blind Africans to believe they can do it," said Suleimon.
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: "And I want to make my country proud again."
sentences.article_title: She lost her sight - now she is fighting to make history for Africa

sentences.text: Jordan Ayew joined Championship side Sheffield United in September after spending two seasons with Leicester City Ghana belatedly kick-started their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (Afcon) qualifying campaign with a 2-0 home win over Somalia.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: The Black Stars had lost their opening two Group C matches against Ivory Coast and The Gambia, leading to the departure of coach Carlos Queiroz by mutual consent.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: Ghana women's coach Kim Bjorkegren was placed in interim charge for this month's double-header against the Ocean Stars, with the West Africans in danger of missing a second successive edition of the Afcon finals.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: The hosts were given a chance to take an early lead in Sekondi-Takoradi after Alidu Seidu was pulled down in the box, but Jordan Ayew's 14th-minute penalty was saved by Somalia goalkeeper Ibrahim Hussein.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: Ghana did go ahead in first-half stoppage time when Mohammed Salisu headed Mohammed Kudus's deep corner back across goal and Jonas Adjetey nodded in from six yards out.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: Felix Afena-Gyan doubled the Black Stars' advantage just after the hour mark when his shot from inside the box squirmed under Hussein and over the line.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: The four-time continental champions remain six points behind group leaders Ivory Coast, who extended their 100% record by beating The Gambia 2-1 in Bouake.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: Brighton midfielder Malick Yalcouye tucked in from seven yards out and Elye Wahi slotted home to double the Elephants' lead before Musa Barrow pulled one back for the visitors before the break.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: Elsewhere on Thursday, there were wins for Cameroon, DR Congo and Senegal, who all remain on track to qualify for next year's tournament in Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: The third round of qualifying fixtures continues on Friday with Egypt, Morocco, Nigeria and South Africa in action among 12 fixtures.
sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.article_title: Ghana kick-start Afcon 2027 bid despite Ayew penalty miss

sentences.text: Tatjana Smith won one gold and one silver medal at both the Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024 Olympic Games The decision by South Africa's most decorated Olympian Tatjana Smith to switch allegiance to the Netherlands is "sad" for the nation, says Swimming South Africa CEO Zikie Molusi.
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: Double Olympic champion Smith, who has dual citizenship because her father is Dutch, was in tears when she announced her decision on Wednesday.
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: She said that the opportunity "offers greater high-performance support" and that South African athletes "deserve a system that gives them an opportunity to thrive, not just survive".
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: "When I received that correspondence from Tatjana we understood because she has been really generous and kind enough to articulate the rationale that informed the decision," Molusi, the acting CEO of the governing body, told eNews Channel Africa.
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: The 29-year-old, who has won four Olympic medals, came out of retirement in September and is set to represent the Netherlands for the first time at the World Championships from 1-6 December.
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: Smith said representing the Netherlands would give her "the potential to build a more sustainable career".
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: She said the "financial and practical challenges of swimming were among the reasons my previous career became difficult to sustain".
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: Speaking to Radio 702, Molusi accepted that Swimming South Africa should not have withheld prize money from Smith following the 2023 World Championships.
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: Molusi said that was caused by conflicting sponsorship agreements but it "shouldn't have happened".
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: Of the 21 athletes competing for South Africa at the Worlds next month, Molusi said "probably 50% will be subsidised fully", with the rest receiving partial support.
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: "It's an ecosystem issue within South African sport that possibly needs to be dealt with," Molusi said.
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: "This comes as a result of the inadequate funding that sport federations are receiving."
sentences.article_title: Smith's Netherlands switch sad - SA swimming boss

sentences.text: Somalia midfielder Jarma Mohamed moved to eighth-tier Jersey Bulls in the summer Not many 21-year-olds can say they have played international football, had spells at Liverpool and Manchester City and are now playing in non-league after being spotted on a mobile app.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: But Jarma Mohamed's footballing journey is not that of your typical midfielder.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: The combative playmaker has been recalled to Somalia's side for their 2027 Africa Cup of Nations (Afcon) qualifiers with Ghana this month, capping a rollercoaster year for the Liverpudlian.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "My mum was probably fed up with me just booting stuff in the house, so she got me involved as early as I could," Mohamed jokes with BBC Sport as he talks about the start of his footballing journey.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "When I was three she was begging teams to take me because the age that you're allowed is four.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "Eventually someone saw me playing and it turned out to be an Everton scout, so I ended up playing for Everton from four and then at that age between four to nine you can play for a few teams.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "It was at Liverpool and Everton, eventually chose Liverpool at nine, then signed for Man City at 11.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: He was released by Wigan in 2024 and spent time in non-league football with Bamber Bridge and Newcastle Town.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: His career came to a crossroads in the summer, when Isthmian League South Central side Jersey Bulls spotted him on an app for footballers.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "I was thinking what do I want to do?," he said.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "I could go abroad and do something, but I wasn't really too sure and I'd been playing showcase games with a company called Player, who basically put players in front of teams, they have an app, which is like a LinkedIn for footballers.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "Jersey Bulls were on the app looking for players and, long story short, the owner of Player put me in contact with Jersey Bulls.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: Born in Toxteth, Mohamed's Somalian grandfather moved to Liverpool, part of a large Somali community in the city.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: It is that heritage that has allowed him to play for a side ranked 200th in the world - the lowest of any team to progress to Afcon 2027's final round of qualifiers.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: He made his Somalia debut against Mauritius in March as the Ocean Stars reached the final qualifying stages for Afcon for the first time in their history - they beat the island nation on penalties after two goalless draws.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "It was a random Wednesday afternoon in my kitchen and I was made up," Mohamed says of the moment he was asked to first join the Somalia squad earlier this year.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: Having reached the qualifying stage for next year's tournament, the lowest ranked side left face a tough group against three-time champions Ivory Coast, The Gambia and Ghana - who have won the tournament four times and drew 0-0 with England in the group stage of this summer's World Cup.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "Everyone's from different parts of the world, you have lads who are Dutch, from Finland, Italy, there's another scouse with me in the team," Mohamed said.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "When we're all there, and even lads who are local and playing in the Somali league, everyone's just one family.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "That's one thing which we're really good at, we're together as a team, there's no egos.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "Everyone's just really together and wanting to get results for the country, which I feel is very important." Somalia were narrowly beaten by the Ivory Coast in September In their first two qualifying matches Somalia have not let themselves down.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: The Gambia scored an 83rd-minute winner to overcome them in their opening game, while an Ivory Coast side boasting Real Madrid's summer signing Yan Diomande, Atalanta's Franck Kessie and former Arsenal winger Nicolas Pepe scored in the 89th minute and the fifth minute of added time to earn a 2-0 win.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: It means the Somalis are second from bottom in Group C on goal difference, above a Ghana side who have Kim Bjorkegren in interim charge after the Black Stars lost their opening two matches under Carlos Queiroz.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: With the tense security situation in Somalia, the Ocean Stars have played all their qualifiers away from home and will face Ghana in back-to-back matches in Takoradi.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: So how will Mohamed, who plays in front of sparse crowds in small grounds in the area south of London, approach facing opponents who ply their trade in the biggest leagues in the world?
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "The same way I treat every game, you can only play what's in front of you," he added.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "If you play the name or an occasion you're losing before you've even kicked a ball.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "I just play who's in front of me and keep it at that.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "You know the players' levels, the qualities that they have that you have to respect, but you also have to back yourself.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "You're sharing the same pitch for a reason, it's not by accident." And can the Ocean Stars make next year's tournament in Kenya, Uganda and Tanzania?
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "The aim is to qualify," he added.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "If you come to do nothing less than that you may as well stay home.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "In the two games we've had previously against Ivory Coast and Gambia we've shown that we can compete.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "If you come to play for the experience or 'we're just happy to be there', then there's no point in coming.
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: "We need to come to try and win."
sentences.article_title: From Jersey to Somalia... via Liverpool & Man City

sentences.text: Ramla Ali was the first boxer from Somalia to compete at an Olympics Ramla Ali secured her first world title at the age of 36 after defeating Mikiah Kreps in a split-decision victory in Arlington, Texas.
sentences.article_title: Somali Olympic boxer Ali weeps as world title dream realised

sentences.text: The win is a crowning moment for the Briton, who fled a war-torn Somalia as a child before going on to become an Olympian, activist, author and now the WBO and IBF super-bantamweight champion.
sentences.article_title: Somali Olympic boxer Ali weeps as world title dream realised

sentences.text: The newly opened Periyar Arivulagam library is at the centre of the allegations An Indian court has ordered an investigation into allegations that a public library in the southern state of Tamil Nadu bought hundreds of books suspected of being generated using AI.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: The controversy began after Tamil novelist Perumal Murugan raised concerns about books containing false information and questionable authorship at a newly opened library in Coimbatore city.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: The Madras High Court has ordered the state's anti-corruption agency to investigate the purchases and freeze bank accounts linked to a publisher accused of supplying the books.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: The state government has blamed the previous Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam (DMK) party-led administration for buying the books.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: The DMK denies allegations.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: Tamil Nadu's School Education Minister A Rajmohan has described the allegations as potentially "India's first AI scam" and said the investigation would cover purchases at other public libraries across the state.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: The case has raised wider questions about the growing use of AI in publishing, where tools can generate entire books quickly and cheaply, but also produce false information and invented references.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: It has also highlighted the challenges facing libraries and publishers in checking the authenticity of books as AI-generated content becomes more widespread.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: The controversy centres on the Periyar Arivulagam library, built at a cost of about 3bn rupees ($34m; £26m).
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: Named after social reformer Periyar EV Ramasamy, it was inaugurated on 16 October by Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: Murugan, whose novels Pyre and One Part Woman have received international recognition, raised concerns after visiting the library last month.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: Writing in an online magazine, he alleged that nearly 1,800 books in its Tamil section had been supplied by a little-known publisher called Agal Vilakku Pathippagam.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: He said many of the books carried unfamiliar authors' names, unusually high prices and questionable International Standard Book Numbers (ISBNs).
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: One book cited in the controversy, Naladiyar Vaazhvin Vazhikatti (A Guide to Life through Naladiyar), was reportedly priced at 1,445 rupees for 300 pages.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: It describes Naladiyar as a Tamil poet and philosopher, although Naladiyar is a classical Tamil work consisting of 400 four-line verses on morality and ethics.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: Another book reportedly attributes the ancient Tamil poem Madurai Kanchi to an incorrect author.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: It remains unclear whether AI was used to produce any of the disputed books.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: The library was inaugurated by Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay Questions have also been raised about a book found at another public library in Madurai which names renowned economist Jean Drèze as its author.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: The book, Democracy and People's Rights in the Contemporary World, names renowned economist Jean Drèze as its author and was published by Phoenix Publishing House.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'

sentences.text: Drèze did not respond to BBC Tamil's request for comment but told The Hindu newspaper earlier this week that he had not written the book, raising concerns that his name may have been used without his permission.
sentences.article_title: New Indian mega library rocked by scandal over 'AI-generated books'
